threats.title: External Entity Identity Spoofing at Guest Web & Mobile Interface
threats.description: External entity 'Guest Web & Mobile Interface' (GuestClient) in zone 'Public Internet' could be impersonated without strong OIDC/MFA or API credential validation.
threats.mitigation: Enforce OIDC/OAuth2 authentication, MFA for staff roles, and mutual certificate validation for 'Guest Web & Mobile Interface'.

threats.title: Non-Repudiation & Action Dispute Risk for Guest Web & Mobile Interface
threats.description: Actions or external callbacks initiated by 'Guest Web & Mobile Interface' (GuestClient) could be repudiated without signed correlation audit logs.
threats.mitigation: Record timestamped, actor-linked immutable audit events for all transactions from 'Guest Web & Mobile Interface'.

threats.description: DFD Process 'Edge WAF & API Gateway' (EdgeGateway) in 'Edge' could allow cross-tenant or unauthorized role execution if RBAC checks fail.
threats.mitigation: Enforce deny-by-default RBAC, resource-level authorization, and least-privilege workload identity in 'Edge WAF & API Gateway'.

threats.description: DFD Data Store 'Regional Transactional Database & Backup Store' (PrimaryDatabase) could be subject to unauthorized record alteration, injection, or backup tampering.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Customer-Managed Key (CMK/TDE) encryption at rest, write-once audit immutability, and strict DB RBAC on 'Regional Transactional Database & Backup Store'.

threats.title: Sensitive Data or Secret Exposure at Rest in Regional Transactional Database & Backup Store
